literal: In lovers' quarrel, those who lost won; that indeed in union will be seen.
translation: Those who lose in a lovers' quarrel are the true winners. That truth will be seen in the joy of their reunion.
modern: காதலர் ஊடலில் தோற்றவரே உண்மையில் வெற்றி பெற்றவர் ஆவார்; அந்த உண்மை அவர்கள் கூடி மகிழும்போது வெளிப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet reveals the paradox of a lovers' quarrel. The one who yields and 'loses' the argument actually wins, because yielding brings the quarrel to an end and leads to the joy of reunion. The word 'தோற்றவர்' (those who lost) is contrasted with 'வென்றார்' (they won) to highlight this irony. The sweetness of the resulting 'கூடல்' (union) proves that losing the quarrel was the true victory.
